properties.name: jusic.room-command.mode
properties.description: Room command adapter. Only 'legacy-local' is supported until all Redis v2 readers, writers, playback jobs and event consumers are migrated; any other value intentionally leaves startup without a RoomCommandService.

properties.name: jusic.room-command.redis-v2.migration-store-enabled
properties.description: Registers an unused Redis v2 migration/prototyping store only. This does not switch Controller traffic to Redis v2 and must not be treated as a production activation flag.

properties.name: jusic.websocket.capacity.node
properties.description: Maximum number of WebSocket sessions registered on one application node. This is a node-local post-handshake limit, not a cluster-wide admission limit.

properties.name: jusic.websocket.capacity.room
properties.description: Maximum number of WebSocket sessions registered for one room on one application node.

properties.name: jusic.websocket.capacity.ip
properties.description: Maximum number of WebSocket sessions registered for one resolved client IP on one application node.

properties.name: jusic.websocket.reaper.enabled
properties.description: Enables periodic removal of locally retained WebSocket sessions whose transport is already closed. This is not an inactivity timeout.

properties.name: jusic.websocket.reaper.fixed-delay
properties.description: Delay in milliseconds between completed scans for locally retained closed WebSocket sessions.

properties.name: jusic.websocket.inbound.core-pool-size
properties.description: Core workers for the bounded WebSocket client-inbound executor.

properties.name: jusic.websocket.inbound.max-pool-size
properties.description: Maximum workers for the bounded WebSocket client-inbound executor.

properties.name: jusic.websocket.inbound.queue-capacity
properties.description: Maximum number of WebSocket inbound messages waiting for an application worker.

properties.name: jusic.websocket.inbound.keep-alive-seconds
properties.description: Idle keep-alive for WebSocket inbound executor workers.

properties.name: jusic.provider.pick.core-size
properties.description: Core workers reserved for point-song provider calls.

properties.name: jusic.provider.pick.max-size
properties.description: Maximum workers reserved for point-song provider calls.

properties.name: jusic.provider.pick.queue-capacity
properties.description: Maximum queued point-song provider calls before fail-fast rejection.

properties.name: jusic.provider.pick.timeout-ms
properties.description: End-to-end point-song provider budget in milliseconds.

properties.name: jusic.provider.search.core-size
properties.description: Core workers reserved for provider search calls.

properties.name: jusic.provider.search.max-size
properties.description: Maximum workers reserved for provider search calls.

properties.name: jusic.provider.search.queue-capacity
properties.description: Maximum queued provider search calls before fail-fast rejection.

properties.name: jusic.provider.search.timeout-ms
properties.description: End-to-end provider search budget in milliseconds.

properties.name: jusic.provider.playback.core-size
properties.description: Core workers reserved exclusively for playback selection and URL refresh.

properties.name: jusic.provider.playback.max-size
properties.description: Maximum workers reserved exclusively for playback provider calls.

properties.name: jusic.provider.playback.queue-capacity
properties.description: Maximum queued playback provider calls before fail-fast rejection.

properties.name: jusic.provider.playback.timeout-ms
properties.description: End-to-end playback provider budget in milliseconds.

properties.name: jusic.provider.background.core-size
properties.description: Core workers reserved for scheduled and maintenance provider calls.

properties.name: jusic.provider.background.max-size
properties.description: Maximum workers reserved for scheduled and maintenance provider calls.

properties.name: jusic.provider.background.queue-capacity
properties.description: Maximum queued background provider calls before fail-fast rejection.

properties.name: jusic.provider.background.timeout-ms
properties.description: End-to-end background provider budget in milliseconds.

properties.name: jusic.provider.http.connect-timeout-ms
properties.description: Hard TCP connection timeout for music provider HTTP calls.

properties.name: jusic.provider.http.read-timeout-ms
properties.description: Hard socket/read timeout for music provider HTTP calls.

properties.name: jusic.provider.http.max-connections
properties.description: Global maximum concurrent Unirest connections.

properties.name: jusic.provider.http.max-connections-per-route
properties.description: Maximum concurrent Unirest connections to one provider route.

properties.name: jusic.presence.enabled
properties.description: Enable expiring Redis markers for legacy room-session hash fields.

properties.name: jusic.presence.namespace
properties.description: Namespace for additive per-WebSocket presence lease keys.

properties.name: jusic.presence.ttl
properties.description: Presence marker TTL in milliseconds; must exceed two heartbeat intervals.

properties.name: jusic.presence.heartbeat-delay
properties.description: Delay in milliseconds between node-local presence lease renewals.

properties.name: jusic.presence.cleanup-delay
properties.description: Delay in milliseconds between Redis ghost-user cleanup scans.

properties.name: jusic.presence.candidate-grace
properties.description: Minimum time an absent lease must remain a cleanup candidate before its legacy HASH field can be deleted; must cover at least two heartbeat intervals.

properties.name: jusic.presence.candidate-ttl
properties.description: Safety TTL for cleanup candidates; must exceed the grace period and cover at least two cleanup intervals.
